name: Steviol glycosides
what_it_is: A sweetener taken from the leaves of the stevia plant; around 300 times sweeter than sugar.
why_its_added: Sweetens drinks and foods without calories.

india.note: Maximum level depends on the food. Examples below.

eu.note: EFSA has assessed the safety of this additive, but we have no public record of its current authorisation in the EU.

eu_safety_opinion.title: Scientific opinion on the extension of the authorisation of use of the food additive steviol glycosides (E 960a–d) and the modification of the acceptable daily intake (ADI) for steviol

replaced_an_older_opinion.title: Scientific opinion on the safety of the extension of use of steviol glycosides -E 960- as a food additive

safe_daily_limit.unit: mg per kg of body weight per day

means: No single-serving limit has been found for this substance. That is not the same as there being no risk from one large serving - it means nobody has published a number.

people_reports.rule: Reports are shown as reports. We count them. We never turn them into a health claim, and we never let them change the sourced facts above.
